title: Fit what is left
hook: A second predictor can correct the first one.

knows: Small arithmetic and the prerequisites listed below.
doesNotKnow: a new squared-loss weak learner fits the current residual, then adds a correction; it is not another independent copy predicting the original target.

misconception: a new squared-loss weak learner fits the current residual, then adds a correction; it is not another independent copy predicting the original target.
objective: a new squared-loss weak learner fits the current residual, then adds a correction; it is not another independent copy predicting the original target.

claims.text: Each correction fits residual means in a fixed stump split after row1, then adds eta=.5 times those leaves. Base targets[0,0,2,2] yield SSE4→1→.25 and predictions1→(.5,.5,1.5,1.5)→(.25,.25,1.75,1.75). Changed[1,1,5,5] gives16→4→1. Incorrectly fitting original targets each time gives4→2→4. Three line styles mark computed rounds and solid points mark targets.

claims.text: The retained two corrections fit the remaining errors. With half-size updates, training squared error goes 4 to 1 to 0.25. Repeatedly adding a fit to the original targets instead gives 4 to 2 to 4. This fixed-split toy demonstrates residual correction, not guaranteed improvement on unseen data.
